Lets apps like PPSSPP and RetroArch use the files on this TV. Just two quick steps:
Needed so apps can read your games and save your progress.
Find “TV File Picker” in the list and switch it on, then press Back.
When Android asks which app to use, pick “TV File Picker” and press “Always”.
Open your game app and choose your folder. This app opens by itself when needed.
This TV has no screen for the file access setting. It can be turned on once from a computer. The steps are on the project page: github.com/mcalago/tv-file-picker
TV File Picker needs permission to see your files. Open the setup screen to allow it.
The app that asked for a file can\'t receive your choice, because “Just once” was used. Go back, select “TV File Picker” when asked, and press “Always”.
A free, open-source file picker for Android and Google TV, made for the remote control. It lets apps such as PPSSPP and RetroArch choose folders and keep reading and writing there.
This app has no internet access, no ads, no tracking and collects no data. It only touches the folders you choose.
